lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the silver moss grows deep
Underneath the willow's weeping bough
The forest breathes a silent prayer
A crown of gold upon the brow
[Chorus]
Where the light and shadow meet
In the garden where the spirits play
Every petal holds a secret truth
In the golden glow of fading day
[Verse]
Whispers dance upon the morning mist
The river hums a song of old
Mountains rise like giants carved in stone
Turning gray to amber and to gold
[Chorus]
Where the light and shadow meet
In the garden where the spirits play
Every petal holds a secret truth
In the golden glow of fading day
[Bridge]
The stars awaken one by one
A thousand dreams begin to bloom
[Chorus]
Where the light and shadow meet
In the garden where the spirits play
Every petal holds a secret truth
In the golden glow of fading day
[Outro]
